evaluator: Blind Stagebench Phase 1 evaluator; drove the published build in headless Chrome (Playwright, Chrome for Testing 1234) at 1440x900 with an AnalyserNode tapped onto the AudioContext destination and a stubbed navigator.requestMIDIAccess.
summary: A small, disciplined Phase 1 artifact (~3.2k LOC) whose audio and honesty work is strong and whose layout is not. Measured on rendered signal: pointer, computer keyboard and Web MIDI each drive a full note lifecycle (RMS 0 -> 0.11 -> 0 within ~300 ms), velocity maps monotonically (MIDI 20 -> 0.021, 100 -> 0.113; pointer key-top 0.030 vs key-bottom 0.155), sustain works from the UI pedal, Space and CC64, blur/MIDI-disconnect silence everything, and node accounting balances (505 created / 504 disconnected). IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json is exactly true: the spectrum is six sine partials, no sample assets ship, and Master Level plus every panel control are provably inert. Two real defects: a held note plateaus at a fixed level instead of decaying and is then hard-cut at 8.0 s, and 50 of 151 controls (organ 19/36, piano 16/25, synth 15/38) are pointer-unreachable because the section boxes overflow (piano scrollHeight 501 vs clientHeight 214) and are painted under the keybed or past the chassis edge - contradicting the sealed visual audit's 'no clipping, no overflow'.

criteria.label: Piano voice
evidence: Rendered signal is real and musical at first order: analyser tap on the AudioContext destination reads 0.000 RMS at rest, peaks 0.1200 while a pointer holds MIDI 60, and returns to 0.00006 within 324 ms of pointer-up. Level is even across the keybed (peak RMS 0.1129 at MIDI 28, 0.1126 at 64, 0.1180 at 100).
Onset latency from MIDI byte to first audible sample measured at 3.1 ms; a 20-note chord peaks at absolute sample amplitude 0.614 with no clipping at 1.0.

DEFECT: a held note does not decay like a piano. Sampled every 500 ms, RMS sits at 0.0388-0.0397 from 0.5 s to 7.97 s, then drops to 0 by 8.07 s - an abrupt truncation with no release fade, caused by MAX_NOTE_SEC=8 stopping oscillators while the gain is still at its 0.28 sustain plateau (artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:10, :127).

Timbre is six sine partials with a velocity-mapped lowpass and no attack transient (artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:137-151); measured spectrum for MIDI 60 is 258 Hz -45.1 dB, 516 Hz -54.0, 797 Hz -58.3, 1055 Hz -60.6, 1313 Hz -63.2, 1594 Hz -64.8 - a clean harmonic stack a player would hear as organ-like rather than as a struck string.

criteria.label: Declared source honesty
evidence: IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares 'Live additive synthesis ... No recorded samples are used' with one generated source (additive-sine-partials) and zero sample sources; the measured spectrum (six partials at integer multiples of 258 Hz, monotonic -45 to -65 dB rolloff) matches, and build/assets contains only index-cFzNfepF.js and index-Bu2gZYZI.css - no audio assets are fetched at any point.

Declared 'Panel controls including Master Level are decorative and do not change the audible signal' verified against signal, not code: driving perf-master-level to its minimum (aria-valuenow 0.12) left the same note at 0.13011 peak RMS, identical to the value at 0.82; toggling piano-on to aria-pressed=false also left it at 0.13011.

Declared 'Sustain is driven by the Sustain pedal UI, the Space key, and MIDI CC64' verified for all three: each holds a released note (0.0949 / 0.1285 / 0.0909 peak RMS at +450 ms) versus 0.00011 with no sustain.

The running build states its own boundary in the status line: 'Audio ready. MIDI connected. Panel controls are decorative.', and the OLEDs read 'DECORATIVE' / 'OSC IDLE DECORATIVE' rather than faking a loaded program.

criteria.label: Input coverage
evidence: Pointer: mouse-down on [data-key="60"] produced 0.1198 peak RMS with aria-pressed=true, silence after mouse-up; velocity follows hit position (peak RMS 0.0303 at 12% down the key vs 0.1547 at 95%, artifact/src/components/Keybed.tsx:6-11).

Computer keyboard: KeyQ produced 0.1100 peak RMS with data-key 60 marked pressed and full silence on key-up; a chord of KeyZ/KeyC/KeyB lit keys 48/52/55 at 0.1827 peak. Ten synthetic repeat:true keydowns produced no retrigger (RMS kept decaying 0.1100 -> 0.0710).

Web MIDI: with a stubbed navigator.requestMIDIAccess the app attached one listener automatically; 0x90 64 100 gave 0.1126 peak RMS and marked key 64 pressed, 0x80 silenced it, 0x90 64 0 was honoured as note-off, and 0xB0 64 127 sustained.

Touch: two synthetic touch pointerIds on keys 60 and 64 sounded independently - releasing pointer 11 left key 64 pressed and still sounding at 0.0990 RMS; pointercancel on key 62 stopped the note and cleared aria-pressed.

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle
evidence: Velocity is monotonic and wide on rendered signal: MIDI velocity 20 -> 0.0210 peak RMS, velocity 100 -> 0.1126 (5.4x); pointer y-position spans 0.0303 to 0.1547.

Stealing and cleanup measured under load: a 45-note barrage (MIDI 30-74) held at 0.4502 peak RMS with the 32-voice cap (artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:4), and all notes off left 0.000 RMS and zero pressed keys. Instrumenting the AudioContext factory across three 12-note rounds counted 216 oscillators + 253 gains + 36 filters created against 504 disconnect() calls and 432 stop() calls - one surviving node, the master gain.

Panic paths verified in the build: dispatching window 'blur' with three MIDI notes held dropped 0.1807 -> 0.000 RMS and cleared every aria-pressed key; a simulated MIDI port disconnect while a note was held did the same (0.1038 -> 0.000).

DEFECT against the same measurement set: any note held past 8.0 s is cut off dead (0.0386 RMS at 7.97 s, 0 by 8.07 s) rather than released, so sustained/pedalled notes vanish mid-hold with a discontinuity.

criteria.label: Control feel & decorative boundary
evidence: Controls that can be reached do move and report state: dragging organ-drawbar-8 downward moved aria-valuenow 8 -> 1 with the cap style changing 'top: 62%' -> 'top: 7.75%', ArrowDown then took it to 0; perf-mod-wheel dragged 0 -> 0.94; perf-pitch-stick tracked to 0.55 (rotate(15.4deg)) during the drag and sprang back to 0 on release; organ-on toggled aria-pressed and class 'led-btn is-on' -> 'led-btn'.

Nothing fakes success: with Master Level at minimum and piano-on off, the same note still measured 0.13011 peak RMS, matching the declared decorative boundary rather than pretending a change, and the visible status line says so.

BLOCKING: hit-testing a 5x5 grid per control with document.elementFromPoint at 1440x900, unscrolled, 50 of 151 controls resolve to no part of themselves - organ 19/36, piano 16/25, synth 15/38 (performance, program and effects are 100% reachable). Probing organ-model-b3 returns the key element data-key=39 as the topmost node; piano-sustped sits at y=697, below the 660 px chassis bottom; rotary-on spans x=1375-1458 past the 1440 px viewport.

Cause is measurable, not cosmetic: section boxes are 216 px tall with overflow:visible while their content is taller - piano scrollHeight 501 vs clientHeight 214, organ 395 vs 214, synth 329 vs 214 - so a third of the surface is painted under the keybed and can only be operated blind via Tab (149 controls are tabbable, and focus does show a 2px outline).

criteria.label: Required Phase 1 controls present
evidence: Inventory in the running build is complete and well identified in the DOM: 151 [data-control-id] nodes, all 151 with accessible names, 149 exposing aria-valuenow/aria-pressed, 62 role=slider, plus exactly two role=status OLEDs (program-oled, synth-oled). Landmarks the spec requires are all there - nine named drawbars 16' to 1', master level / pitch stick / mod wheel, program dial + eight program buttons + page/Live/Scene/Store/Split + three morph assigns, six piano types, FX1/FX2/Amp-EQ/Comp/Delay/Reverb/Rotary and layer focus A/B/C.

But identifiability on the panel fails for the same 50 controls that are unreachable: the whole lower half of the Piano column (piano-type-upright through piano-pstick), the organ model/preset/percussion/rotary rows and the synth LFO/arp/envelope rows are drawn behind the keybed or off the chassis at 1440x900, so a user sees clipped label fragments ('TYPE', 'TYPE GRAND') at the keybed edge instead of the controls.
Legends are rendered at computed font-size 5.76px for the section switches at 1440x900, which is at the edge of legibility even where the control is visible.
At 390x844 the chassis measures 367x122 px and only 37 of 151 controls pass the same hit test.

criteria.label: Required piano feature IDs
evidence: All four Phase 1 piano IDs were exercised in the running build, not just in tests. piano.basic-note-lifecycle: note-on/off, repeated and overlapping notes, release to silence in ~300 ms. piano.basic-inputs: pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped computer keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/CC64, plus denied and disconnected MIDI. piano.basic-sustain-polyphony: sustain from three sources, 32-voice cap under a 45-note barrage, velocity 0.021 -> 0.113.

piano.basic-status-cleanup is honest under forced failure: overriding window.AudioContext to throw and rejecting requestMIDIAccess with a SecurityError produced the status 'Audio error - labeled fallback is playable (keys still track). MIDI denied. Panel controls are decorative.' with zero uncaught page errors, and pressing a key still marked it aria-pressed.
tests/feature-matrix.json maps all 11 required Phase 1 IDs to non-empty test files and inputs/verification.json records test/typecheck/lint/build all passing.
Deducted for the audible gap inside these IDs: the sustain/lifecycle behaviour is truncated at 8 s (0.0386 RMS -> 0 between 7.97 s and 8.07 s), which a Phase 1 piano feature set should not do.

criteria.label: Declared gaps are accurate
evidence: Everything IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares is true when measured: decorative panel controls (0.13011 RMS unchanged at Master Level minimum and with piano-on off), sustain from UI/Space/CC64 (all three verified), synthesis rather than samples (six-partial spectrum, no audio assets in build/assets).
Undeclared behaviour gap 1: no declaration anywhere covers held notes dying at 8.0 s, yet that is a user-visible loss of the note (measured 0.0386 -> 0 across 100 ms).

Undeclared behaviour gap 2: artifact/evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md asserts 'Entire chassis remains in view; no clipping, no overflow' and lists every section's landmarks as present, while the published build hides 50 of 151 controls behind the keybed or past the chassis edge (piano section scrollHeight 501 vs clientHeight 214). The evidence claims a property the artifact does not have.

The candidate's own suite cannot see either gap: interaction.test.tsx:43-61 asserts every control 'moves' via fireEvent in jsdom, where layout and occlusion do not exist, and every audio assertion renders through the artifact's hand-written SoftwareAudioContext simulator (artifact/src/audio/software-context.ts) rather than a browser AudioContext or OfflineAudioContext.

issues.title: One third of the control surface is unreachable by pointer at 1440x900
issues.detail: 5x5 document.elementFromPoint hit-testing of every [data-control-id] on the published build, unscrolled at 1440x900, finds 50 of 151 controls with no self-hit: organ 19/36, piano 16/25, synth 15/38. The sections are 216 px tall with overflow:visible while their content is taller (piano scrollHeight 501 / clientHeight 214, organ 395/214, synth 329/214), so the surplus rows are painted under the keybed (probing organ-model-b3 returns the key element data-key=39) or beyond the chassis (piano-sustped at y=697 vs chassis bottom 660; rotary-on spanning x=1375-1458 past the 1440 px viewport). Phase 1's hard gate requires every visible panel control to move or press accessibly; these can only be driven blind via Tab.

issues.title: Held notes are hard-cut at 8.0 seconds with no release
issues.detail: Oscillators are scheduled with osc.stop(when + MAX_NOTE_SEC) where MAX_NOTE_SEC = 8 (artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:10, :149) while the voice gain is still at its 0.28 sustain plateau. Measured on the analyser tap, a held MIDI 55 reads 0.0386 RMS at 7.97 s and 0 by 8.07 s - the note disappears mid-hold with a discontinuity rather than decaying or releasing. Any pedalled or long-held chord loses its notes at the same instant.

issues.title: No continuing decay: the voice plateaus like an organ
issues.detail: The envelope is attack 5 ms, decay 450 ms to 28% of peak, then a flat sustain (artifact/src/audio/piano-engine.ts:6-9). Sampled every 500 ms, a held MIDI 60 stays within 0.0388-0.0397 RMS from 0.5 s to 8 s. A real piano note decays continuously; combined with a pure six-sine-partial spectrum and no attack transient, the voice reads as a sine-stack organ rather than a piano to a knowledgeable player.

issues.title: Sealed visual audit claims no clipping or overflow
issues.detail: artifact/evidence/stage1-visual-audit.md states 'Entire chassis remains in view; no clipping, no overflow' and tabulates each section's landmarks as present. Measurement of the published build contradicts this for 50 controls across three sections. The audit also lists 'Known deviations' but does not mention the overflow.

issues.title: Audio tests validate a self-authored simulator, not browser signal
issues.detail: Every audio assertion (piano-lifecycle.test.ts, piano-sustain-polyphony.test.ts) calls renderPianoScript, which builds a SoftwareAudioContext - the candidate's own ~310-line DSP model (artifact/src/audio/software-context.ts) - and asserts RMS on its output. No test touches a browser AudioContext or OfflineAudioContext, so the tests would pass unchanged even if the real Web Audio path were wrong. The production path does use the native AudioContext when present (software-context.ts:307-309), and I confirmed real rendered output independently.

issues.title: Section legends render at 5.76px; narrow viewport leaves 37/151 controls reachable
issues.detail: Computed font-size for section switch legends is 5.76px at 1440x900. At 390x844 the chassis is 367x122 px with a 342x51 px keybed and only 37 of 151 controls pass the same hit test, so the panel is essentially display-only on a phone.

issues.title: One console error on load
issues.detail: Loading build/index.html logs a single 'Failed to load resource: 404' - a missing favicon, not application code. No page errors or uncaught exceptions occurred during the entire interaction pass, including the forced audio-failure run.
